slices.red: A frozen closure above one Codex context window can only produce a failed reviewer payload or exhaust context; no parent-owned segmented coverage path exists.
slices.green: One reviewer role can execute isolated bounded segments, each with hash-bound Artifact View range coverage, and parent publication requires the exact aggregate coverage before formal output exists.
slices.regression: Run the focused Bootstrap regression tests, whole-directory compatibility validator, and skill quick validation.

composition.receipt: parent-validated aggregate segment coverage and one formal reviewer output

slices.red: An existing preferred proof is returned when run-layer requests an allowed fallback model, so no model-bound fallback proof exists.
slices.green: An explicit fallback action creates and validates a distinct model-bound proof sidecar without silently reusing the preferred proof.
slices.regression: Run the focused fallback proof test and the complete Bootstrap regression suite.

composition.receipt: fallback proof sidecar hash and selected-model validation receipt

slices.red: A controller interruption can leave an event-backed live descendant past the no-progress bound without a controller-owned terminal transport event.
slices.green: The controller launches the complete child tree in a recoverable process group and a bounded watchdog emits the terminal append-only transport event after tree termination.
slices.regression: Run the focused Bootstrap regression tests, whole-directory compatibility validator, and skill quick validation.

composition.receipt: event-backed no-progress terminal state and reconstructed non-acquired lease
